PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Keyboard
   C. CPU
   D. Speaker

2. When learning Ceramic Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ceramic Materials.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Ceramic Materials.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ceramic Materials.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ceramic Materials.

3. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Overload every socket

4. When learning Data Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Data Safety.

   D. Input Cable Tester

9. When learning Computer Software, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Software.

   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Software.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Computer Software.

10. When learning Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools , the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

11. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Remove all guards
